lines.zh: 我爬得很慢，身上有点凉。
lines.en: I crawl slowly. There's a chill on me.

lines.zh: 叶面一层薄霜，我压着走。
lines.en: A thin frost on the leaf. I crawl over it.
I'm paler than other caterpillars.

lines.zh: 我一节一节缩，再一节一节伸。
lines.en: I bunch up, then stretch out, segment by segment.
I follow the leaf edge, avoiding the frost.

lines.zh: 我走一段，就停下来缓一缓。
lines.en: A stretch of crawling, then I stop to recover.

lines.zh: 叶子已经黄了，可我还能吃。
lines.en: The leaf has yellowed, but it's still food.

lines.zh: 脚踩在叶脉上，抓得稳些。
lines.en: On the vein my feet grip better.
I go around the dead patches.

lines.zh: 身体僵，动起来一顿一顿。
lines.en: My body is stiff. I move in jerks.

lines.zh: 我朝有阳光的那半叶去。
lines.en: I head for the sunny half of the leaf.
Every step is small. Careful.

lines.zh: 霜把叶边冻硬，我绕内侧走。
lines.en: Frost has hardened the leaf edge, so I keep inboard.

lines.zh: 风一过，我整条身子都缩了。
lines.en: A gust comes and my whole body shrinks.

lines.zh: 我把前半身探到叶缘外。
lines.en: I stretch my front half past the leaf edge.
I pull back. Too cold.
Pressed to the leaf, stillness is warmest.
The leaf is stiff. Chewing is hard work.
I chew slowly. No rush.

lines.zh: 身上的霜化了，湿了一片。
lines.en: The frost on me melted into a wet patch.
I move little. Moving makes me colder.
The sun's reached this half now.

lines.zh: 我把身子摊平，多晒一点。
lines.en: I flatten out to catch more sun.

lines.zh: 叶柄只剩一条细线还连着。
lines.en: Only a thin thread of stem still holds.

lines.zh: 我数着叶上还剩几处好地方。
lines.en: I count the good patches left on the leaf.
Something's on the underside. I leave it.

lines.zh: 平原的叶子上，我只吃这一片。
lines.en: On a plains leaf, I eat only this one.
When it warms, I'll eat a few more bites.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，我感觉得到。
lines.en: I can feel the heat off you.
Not so close. Your shadow is cold.

lines.zh: 你要把我放到别的叶上？
lines.en: Will you move me to another leaf?
I mustn't end up on the ground.
Your hand is warm. I daren't touch it.
The leaf shakes, and so do I.

lines.zh: 这片叶子是我的，别拿走。
lines.en: This leaf is mine. Don't take it.
Watch me all you like. I won't go faster.

lines.zh: 我缩了一下，不是怕，是冷。
lines.en: I flinched. Not fear — cold.

lines.zh: 你要帮我，就找片有太阳的叶。
lines.en: If you'd help, find a leaf in the sun.

lines.zh: 我的身子被压扁了一块。
lines.en: Part of me is squashed flat.
I rolled off and caught the stem.

lines.zh: 冷的汁流出来，很快凝住。
lines.en: Cold fluid seeps out and quickly thickens.
I stay perfectly still, playing dead.
Don't squeeze. I'll break.
It takes me a long while to recover.
Pain runs down my middle.
The vein is still in my grip.
After any movement I have to rest.
That made me even slower.
This leaf looks edible.
I take a bite. A bit tough.
The tender part is in the middle.
Hold it to my mouth. I'll bite.
Eating will warm me a little.
I gnaw slowly. It takes a long time.
This one will last until tomorrow.
Easier to chew than the one under me.

lines.zh: 这一口有点甜，我多咬了些。
lines.en: This bite is a little sweet, so I take more.
Leave another one beside it.
One touch and I rolled half over.
Don't. My body is brittle.
The leaf sways. My grip is failing.
I curl up and recover slowly.
Your weight makes the leaf dip.
I dropped to the other side of the leaf.
Don't push me with a fingertip.
I'm holding the vein. Don't move the leaf.
We bumped and I didn't move for a while.
I crawl slowly back to the middle.
In this cold, survival first.
Are you waiting for me to become a butterfly too?
Pressed together, we'd be warmer.

lines.zh: 同一片叶子，我们分着吃。
lines.en: We'll share this one leaf.
Don't move. Slowly.

lines.zh: 结蛹之前，我们还能这样。
lines.en: Before pupating, we can have this.
I'm cold. Don't mind it.
Later, we'll both fly.

lines.zh: 到那时候，颜色会亮起来。
lines.en: By then, our colors will brighten.
You eat first. I'm in no hurry.
You've lifted me up.
Put me on a leaf, not the ground.
The leaf's over there. The sunny one.
I'm too stiff to grip you.
Gently. I'll snap.

lines.zh: 你手上暖，我缓过来一点。
lines.en: Your hand is warm. I'm recovering a little.
A bit more left. There.
I'm down. Holding on.
This leaf is cold.
Thank you. You can let go.
There's a patch of leaf not yet withered.
I crawl toward the light.
This part's too tough to chew.
Scooting slowly so the leaf stays still.
First, check whether that spot is safe.
Just that little patch. Enough.
No hurry. I can't crawl fast.

lines.zh: 枯叶那头有点绿，我看见了。
lines.en: There is green at the far end of the dead leaf.
There's sun there.
I'm starting to crawl now.
I keep heading that way.
The leaf dips; I stop.
Still a way to go.
I go around this withered patch.
Two inches on, I stop to rest.
Nearly there. Nearly at the edge.

lines.zh: 那里有暖意，我感觉得到。
lines.en: There's warmth there. I can feel it.

lines.zh: 冷风一吹，我又缩成一团。
lines.en: The cold wind blows and I curl up again.
Two more inches and I'm there.
At the leaf edge at last.
Head up, one bump against the leaf.
I'm so slow I can't hit much.
I spit silk to stick to it.

lines.zh: 我甩动身子，把它甩开去。
lines.en: I whip my body around to throw it off.
All I can do is guard the leaf.
I bite. My jaws are soft.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来顶它一下。
lines.en: I raise my head and butt at it once.
That took all my strength.
I roll into a ball to protect myself.
I'll go back to the middle of the leaf.
I hatch from the egg. It's cold.
A white frost on the leaf.
I take a small bite to test.
My color is paler than the others'.
Even moving is an effort.
I crawl to the vein.
In this meadow the flowers are gone.

lines.zh: 我得吃得够多，才熬得过去。
lines.en: I must eat enough to last.
The wind's stopped. I move while I can.

lines.zh: 我趴在叶子上，一点一点啃。
lines.en: I lie on the leaf and nibble it away.

lines.zh: 火一近，我身上的霜全化了。
lines.en: Fire neared and the frost on me melted away.

lines.zh: 从叶上掉到地上，摔得很实。
lines.en: I fell from the leaf and hit the ground hard.

lines.zh: 水冷得像针，我一泡就僵。
lines.en: The water is needle-cold; I stiffen at once.
The blast swept me off the leaf.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过我，我断了一下。
lines.en: Something went through me. I buckled.

lines.zh: 光一闪，我整条身子抽紧。
lines.en: A flash, and my whole body clenched.

lines.zh: 叶子吃完了，我越来越硬。
lines.en: The leaf is gone. I grow stiffer.
Thunder came and I clenched up, unable to move.

lines.zh: 这里没有叶，也没有暖和的地方。
lines.en: No leaves here. Nothing warm at all.
